evidence.reason: The test sets both the owned-process and unrelated-process liveness fields to false before a single harness.build_checks call. Because drain_alive_refused is a binary assertion, an implementation that checks only one of those two fields would still make the assertion pass, so the test does not independently exercise both preservation conditions named by the test. Splitting the two mutations into separate fresh-fixture subtests is a routine test-correctness repair, not a new product requirement.
